design.bootstrap: none; not implemented in WP-C3; no new intervals or significance claims

endpoints.far_delta: rule minus L1 averaged over hops 6,7,8
endpoints.reach_delta: rule minus L1 averaged over hops 2,3

design.halting_convention: predict at first qualifying post-update state z^L, 1<=L<=16; unchanged WP-C3 rules
design.oracle_reference: true-hop stop is label-informed, not an accuracy upper bound
design.read_norm_cost: L+1 memory reads including final diagnostic; other rules cost L reads
design.scope: evaluation only; released F2 and WP-H r32 checkpoints; no confirmation episodes
design.screening_candidate: hop1_delta >= -0.01, reach_delta > 0, walk_specificity > 0; point estimates only, not formal G1 acceptance
design.selection: WP-C3 maximum validation mean accuracy over eight hops and three seeds; ties: fewer mean steps, then smaller threshold
design.selection_barrier: save thresholds after all validation traces and before any screening-test trace
design.smoke: six families, seed17, 200 validation episodes, no selection or screening scores
design.threshold_scope: one per writer/rank/variant family and criterion, shared across three seeds

metadata.selection_weighting: equal mean over training seeds and hops
